sources.title: GitHub - SceneWorks/SceneWorks
sources.snippet: SceneWorks SceneWorks is a desktop-native AI image, video, and audio generation studio. It runs generation directly on your machine's GPU — MLX on macOS (Apple Silicon) and candle / CUDA on Windows and Linux (NVIDIA) — with no Python, no cloud, and no Docker required. Your prompts, models, and media never leave the workstation.
